profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Senior Software Developer Engineer in Test
Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
- Developed internal tooling to manage release management and integration workflows
- Contributed designs/implementations to core production .NET backend processing/delivery
- Contributed designs/implementations to core production Javascript browser client application
- Reviewed product specifications to improve test case coverage and improve test quality and effectiveness by working with Development team.
- Performed Front-end and Back-end testing, performance tests, acceptance tests, functional tests, ad-hoc tests, and regression tests for all partners.
- Build out and configuration of the full stack of search application on Amazon Web Service (AWS)
- Set up Jenkins job to trigger the test when the Front-end or Back-end builds checked-in by Developer.
- Develop integration tests that can be test on different builds. 
- Run automation test to verify both Hosted and XML API partners
- Developed test plans and test cases for the complex partners
- Experienced client-server and web tester.  Performed detailed analysis of test results and automation test cases.
- Developed tools that support testing such as Google- Generate Click Urls, import test configuration to Raven Database.
- Developed tier-one-partner (Important Customer) monitor tool and send auto email if there is problem occurs.
- Developed Back-End automation to verify XML feed to ensure the XML feed return and working properly.
- Validate released product by working with Cloud Operating team.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Performed acceptance tests, functional tests, ad-hoc tests, and regression tests for XPSP2.
•	Run automation test to verify binaries, kills bits, registry key set are registered properly.
•	Setup and run stress test, sanity tests for XPSP2. 
•	Create and restore system images.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Site development and maintenance, Web marketing strategies 
•	Develop Web site and template to deploy modular, easily updated sites
•	Build and refine style sheets for all pages through out the site.
•	Produce ASP-driven forms 
•	Create and optimize web graphics 
•	Provide tech support for clients 
•	Generate and analyze weekly and monthly Web metrics reports.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Performed acceptance tests, functional tests, ad-hoc tests, and regression tests on the web sites that design by Crossgain Company.
•	Setup and performed Front and Back-end testing with application server on Unix system. 
•	Modified their test cases to match the current design.  Executed and verified these test cases on customer Web pages against the test and ship environments.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Developed test plans and test cases for testing Clarify Application. 
•	Performed functional tests, test pass, ad-hoc tests, regression tests, and integration tests on the Clarify Application.
•	Collected and saved information from customer into SQL database using Clarify Application.   
•	Retrieved data from SQL using Clarify Application.   
•	Developed test tool using ADO connection to link to Clarify Apps.  This tool used to verify the connection between Clarify Apps and SQL database.
•	Setup the Email Clerk, Rule Manager and Voicemail applications to retrieve and execute data for U.S and International customers.   Verified customer’s information are correctly stored and retrieved from Clarify database.
